description: Strong and self-reliant, goliaths consider the individual to be supreme, yet they recognize that strength in numbers keeps a community alive.

features.name: Natural Athlete
features.tldr: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

features.name: Stone's Endurance
features.tldr: You can focus your rocky resilience to shrug off damage. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12 and reduce the damage by that total plus your Constitution modifier.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.tldr: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

features.name: Mountain Heritage
features.tldr: Choose a goliath mountain origin reflecting your clan's high-altitude adaptation.

features.name: Mountain Born
features.tldr: You have resistance to cold damage and naturally adapt to high altitudes without suffering thin-air fatigue.

features.name: Titan Strike
features.tldr: Your connection to giant ancestry lets you channel extra force into your physical attacks once per turn.
